newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT NATAL IN SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT NATAL IN SEMIFINAL.

text.p: The Auckland Blues beat the Natal Sharks 55-36 (half-time 33-5) in a Super 12 semifinal match at Auckland's Eden Park on Saturday.
Auckland Blues - Tries: Eroni Clarke (2), Joeli Vidiri (2), Mark Carter, Zinzan Brooke, Carlos Spencer, Adrian Cashmore. Conversions: Adrian Cashmore (6). Penalties: Adrian Cashmore.
Natal Sharks - Tries: Shaun Payne (2), Joos Joubert (2), Henry Honiball, Errol Stewart. Conversions: Honiball (3).
